title: three-field scalar association existence
statement: For three successive coefficient maps, the actual quotient scalar maps admit a nonempty balanced ordinary and derived association as in [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension].

source.place: Integral operations and normalized coefficient reduction model.

proof.text: Prove composition of the finite quotient maps by quotient induction. Functorial constant sheafification gives composition of quotient sheaf maps, and the unique sectionwise specification gives composition of their sequence-ring maps.

Construct the identity-on-sections restriction composition isomorphism. Its ordinary left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism has the required balanced tensor formula: apply the unit comparison on a section, then scalar linearity and semilinearity.

Extend each recorded transpose-model equation from K-flat source complexes to arbitrary source complexes: choose a K-flat resolution, precompose by its invertible localization, and use counit and adjunction naturality. Compose the resulting two transpose equations using mapDerivedCategoryCompNatIso_hom_app_Q. The derived left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism then has exactly the required universal-counit normalization, because its transpose is the ordinary unit comparison in each degree.

proof_origin.place: X3 proof: uniqueness of ordinary and derived left adjoints, with compatibility proved from normalized transpose equations.
